AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Village child
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] spent {PAWN_gender ? his : her} entire childhood in a small coastal village. Rarely did anyone go there.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Hunter child
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: As a child, [PAWN_nameDef] lost relatives in one of the raids, which forced {PAWN_gender ? him : her} to forage for {PAWN_gender ? his : her} own food.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Young gatherer
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef ]'s parents gathered their food by gathering and taught [PAWN_nameDef] a lot.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Chief child
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: The father of [PAWN_nameDef] was the chieftain of a small coastal village. Father forced [PAWN_nameDef] to learn battle techniques.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Young artisan
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] made pottery for the community with {PAWN_gender ? his : her} family.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Salt gatherer
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] has been assigned to collect salt offshore for use by the tribal community.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Apostate
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] from childhood disliked the way of life of {PAWN_gender ? his : her} people. He strove to improve the life of the community, but was often condemned. Ultimately, [PAWN_nameDef] leaves the village.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Seeker
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] spends his childhood on constant exploration trips. Stealth is {PAWN_gender ? his : her} middle name.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Journeyman
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] helped the chef with his daily work to feed the village.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Young fisherman
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] fished offshore to help {PAWN_gender ? his : her} community solve hunger.
